definition: Rodney Allen Brooks (born 30 December 1954) is an Australian roboticist and Fellow of the Australian Academy of Science who popularized the actionist approach to robotics.
details: Behavior-based robotics, iRobot and Rethink Robotics co-founder. He was a Panasonic Professor of Robotics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and former director of the MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. He is a founder and former chief technical officer of iRobot and co-founder, chairman and chief technical officer of Rethink Robotics (formerly Heartland Robotics) and is the co-founder and chief technical officer of Robust.AI (founded in 2019).
